name: Denise Fadden
title: Real Estate Assistant
bio: Denise began working with Davis Steadman Percy & Sluka in 2007. She works in both the White River Junction and Woodstock offices, primarily assisting with real estate transactions, and additionally supports both locations administratively.

name: Sally
title: Office Dog (2004–2018)
bio: We deeply miss Sally (2004 to 2018), who graced our office with her cheerful presence and tail-wagging for many years.

name: Lyla
title: Office Dog — Miniature Australian Shepherd
bio: A native of Oregon, Lyla moved to Vermont in 2013 as an 8-week-old puppy. She's often found relaxing in Todd's office and is known for her calm demeanor.
